findings.statement: D-042R prospective-chain admission fails at XG-00-PROVENANCE/ISOLATION, independently of the numerical claims. The archive contains zero EXPERIMENT_CONTRACT.json files, zero run_lab.sh files, zero stdout/stderr/log files, and no digest-pinned network-off OCI record. The only manifest excludes every harness JSON. requirements.txt contains unpinned numpy and scipy. run_experiment.py accepts --repo, inserts repo/src into sys.path, imports rabbit.decoupling._independent_noqke, and executes the live collision evaluator; the low-order runner does the same. The package evaluates full Reynolds, WF-OR, and ORAFS rather than one finalist selected under a prospective contract, and the final raw JSON lacks the mandatory exact_command, input_hashes, output_hashes, tool_versions, assumptions, tolerance/exact form, seed, peak RSS, finding IDs, and raw failure path. These are hard missing prospective bytes and isolation violations, so the strongest supported D-042R route verdict is PROVENANCE_FAIL; the current outputs cannot be retrospectively sealed.
assumptions_used: D-042R Sections 1, 5, 6, 7, and 11 are binding for prospective admission.
Missing contract/chronology/raw bytes and a forbidden live production import are structural failures not curable by favorable numerical output.
No scientific Python, collision evaluator, or external runner was executed during this intake.

findings.statement: The returned report itself is nonconforming and cannot request intake. It uses STATIC_BLOCKER_MOVED / GLOBAL_GATES_UNCHANGED instead of one of the four allowed route verdicts, recommends a next implementation despite no all-gate finalist, omits PR_DAG=UNREACHABLE, omits the mandatory accounting block, and ends without exactly DO_NOT_REOPEN or REQUEST_OWNER_AUTHORIZATION_FOR_ONE_EXTERNAL_CANDIDATE_INTAKE_REVIEW. The defensible claim ceiling is: ZIP integrity VALIDATED; external lab code IMPLEMENTED externally but not internally replayed and not a production remedy; row-6 localization external evidence only and internally unverified; OCAR, RCHEB-EVP12, and TFC-DE remain PROPOSED; package admission PROVENANCE_FAIL; no global gate changes. STOP/PRESERVE remains binding and any candidate-specific PR DAG is UNREACHABLE.
